whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Is Your Product Good But Hard to Use?
whatIs.paragraph1: Do you have a great product but users can't figure it out, can't complete their tasks, or drop off halfway through?
whatIs.paragraph2: Poor UX is not just an aesthetic problem — it means lost conversions, high churn and customer dissatisfaction.
whatIs.paragraph3: At Sybor Digital, we design intuitive, accessible and conversion-focused interfaces through user research, competitor analysis and a data-driven design process.

growing.title: Enterprise software
growing.description: I want to turn complex internal processes into easy-to-use interfaces.

global.title: Mobile application
global.description: I want a consistent, user-friendly experience for iOS and Android.

whatWeDo.label: What We Do
whatWeDo.title: Full UX Process from Research to Prototype
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We start with user interviews, competitor analysis and analytics data. Design decisions are backed by data, not intuition.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We prepare wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes, validate them with user testing and iterate.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: We deliver the design system we create in Figma to your development team — every element documented, every component reusable.
whatWeDo.cardDescription: Everything you need for your UI/UX project — under one roof.

whyUs.label: Why Us
whyUs.title: Why Sybor Digital?
whyUs.subtitle: A team that thinks about design and development together.

reason1.title: Data-Driven Decisions
reason1.description: Every design decision is backed by user research or analytics data. We don't guess.

reason2.title: We Understand Development
reason2.description: We don't design things that can't be built. As a team that understands technical constraints, we produce implementable solutions.

reason3.title: Accessibility Standard
reason3.description: WCAG 2.1 compliant designs. We care about the experience of every user.

reason4.title: Transparent Process
reason4.description: We get your approval at every stage. No surprises — every decision is explained.

reason5.title: Fast Delivery
reason5.description: We iterate quickly without long waiting times, through an efficient design process.

reason6.title: Long-Term Support
reason6.description: We update the design system as your product grows. Not a one-time handoff — a partnership.

discovery.description: We conduct user research, competitor analysis and evaluate the existing product. We identify design opportunities.

design.title: Wireframe & Design
design.description: We prepare information architecture, user flows and high-quality UI designs.

development.title: Prototype & Testing
development.description: We build an interactive prototype and test it with real users. We iterate.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does a UI/UX project take?
delivery.answer: Varies by scope. A single app flow takes 1-2 weeks, a full product design can take 4-8 weeks.

pricing.question: Do you only do design, or development too?
pricing.answer: Both. We offer design-only or design + development packages.

revisions.question: How many revisions do I get?
revisions.answer: Unlimited revisions at every stage. We don't move to the next phase without your approval.

maintenance.question: Are the design files handed over to me?
maintenance.answer: Yes. Figma files, assets and design system documentation are all delivered in full.

migration.question: Can you redesign my existing product?
migration.answer: Yes. We analyze your existing product, identify problems through user testing and redesign it.

mobile.question: Do you design for both web and mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. We build design systems for responsive web, iOS and Android. We ensure a consistent experience.
